profile.headline: Motion Planning & Controls Engineer at Pickle Robot Company
profile.summary: Robotics researcher and engineer with a passion for advancing both research and practical applications in robotics. I excel in the application of complex dynamical systems, using a blend of simulation, modeling, and hands-on hardware expertise. My work bridges hardware and software to develop robust robotic infrastructure.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
• Led a comprehensive robot behavior analysis initiative, delivering recommendations across perception, planning, and navigation.  
• Architected a ground-up navigation framework to meet stringent performance and safety standards.  
• Spearheaded the deployment of a new robotic gripper, boosting system performance.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Led simulation research for a NASA LuSTR grant, focusing on lunar terrain mechanics and multi-robot locomotion.  
• Developed a robust software infrastructure for multi-robot coordination in extreme environments, enhancing real-world experimental performance.  
• Engineered a deployable ultra-light hyperextendable wing for quadrotors, improving UAV versatility for diverse efficiency needs.  
• Expanded an RTOS brushless motor control SDK for legged robots, providing comprehensive documentation for future research applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Modeling and Simulation · Applied Mathematics · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) · SolidWorks

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
-Real-Time ML Algorithm: Developed a physics-based ML algorithm for position and force prediction on soft robots using magnetic fields, enabling our lab to deploy mobile soft robots outside of controlled environments.
-Surgical Robot Characterization: Investigated the performance of a printed nylon concentric tube robot, contributing to advancements in robotic surgery by improving the material’s functionality and reliability.

positions.title: Student Assistant for Controls Engineering, Unified Robotics III & IV
positions.description:
-Hands-On Controls Labs: Facilitated practical labs using MATALAB and nonlinear balance robots, enhancing students’ understanding of robotics control principles.
-Autonomous Robotics Projects: Guided students in developing autonomous robotics projects, including A* pathfinding, SLAM, and MCL, equipping then with essential skills for autonomous robot locomotion.

positions.title: NSF REU Fellow
positions.description:
-Tunable Stiffness Spring Design: Engineered a coiled spring with variable stiffness, providing a versatile actuator framework for advanced soft robotics applications.
Optimization Model Development: Created a differential equation optimization model for large nonlinear ring compressions, improving actuator performance and enabling control of complex multi-spring structures.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: -Advanced RADAR Processing: Taught backprojection algorithms and RADAR processing techniques for synthetic aperture RADAR, preparing students for implementing advanced radar solutions.

educations.schoolName: North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics

honors.title: REU Grant
honors.description: NSF REU grant for soft robotics work on tunable stiffness spring

honors.title: REU Grant
honors.description: NSF REU grant for soft robotics work on soft sensors

volunteerExperiences.description: Intern at Mixxer, a non-profit maker space, helping with projects such as constructing a low-cost persistence of vision display, representing Mixxer at events, and helping set up their new facility in Winston-Salem. These efforts assisted with Mixxer’s public launch.
Mentor for local FTC Robotics teams in CAD, mechanical systems, control systems, and computer vision.

publications.title: Design and Control of a Tunable-Stiffness Coiled-Spring Actuator
publications.publisher: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) · May 29, 2023

publications.title: Real-Time Magnetic Sensing for Soft 3-DoF Continuum Robots
